title: Geld voor kunstkopers 1977
authors: Welters, L.A., Eykman, C., Boekmanstichting * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
contributors: Ministerie van cultuur recreatie en maatschappelijk werk, CRM * Rijswijk (research initiator)
descriptions: Description of subscribers of 'lending art galleries'. Use of galleries that lend art / impact of prices / appreciation of supply / the system of loan and hire-purchase of art / service purchase of works of art / motives for membership / sources of information / cooperation with public lending libraries / visits to museums / membership "Openbaar Kunstbezit" / preferred type of art gallery / motivation / attending performances of art. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
